title: 控制层级
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/017_控制层级.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/017_控制层级/src.py

points.K1: 降低风险：熟悉的规则从哪里来
points.K7: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
points.K9: 管理控制：改变做事方式
points.K11: 管理措施靠执行和监督
points.K12: 个人防护是最后一道防线
points.K13: 靠防护挡住，说明前面失守
points.K15: 学生在实验室能做的三层
points.S1: 发现措施缺失，及时报告

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个五层倒金字塔图，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an inverted pyramid diagram with five blank layers and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲控制层级。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层依次亮起，每层一个图标
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid lights up layer by layer, each layer with one simple icon: a cross, a swap arrow, a shield wall, a clipboard and a glove. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估完了，怎么把风险降下来？

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一副手套，准备做一个有挥发性试剂的实验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a pair of gloves, about to start an experiment with a volatile reagent at an open bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：戴上手套就行了吧？

shots.scene: 老周摆手拦住他
shots.prompt_en: The older man raises a hand to stop the young male student.
shots.narration: 老周说：安全不是从手套开始的。

shots.scene: 老周指着倒金字塔的最底层
shots.prompt_en: The older man points to the narrow bottom layer of an inverted pyramid chart.
shots.narration: 手套在最底层，是最后一招。

shots.scene: 阿杰吃惊地张大嘴
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks surprised, mouth open.
shots.narration: 阿杰吃惊：手套效果最差？

shots.section_title: 降低风险：熟悉的规则从哪里来
shots.scene: 四步流程图，第三步“降低风险”亮起
shots.prompt_en: A four-step flow chart with the third step highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 降低风险，是风险管理的第三步。
overlay: 降低风险：熟悉的规则从哪里来

shots.section_title: 降低风险：熟悉的规则从哪里来
shots.scene: 通风柜、护目镜、手套和实验服四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a fume hood, safety goggles, gloves and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 进通风柜、戴护目镜，都为降风险。

shots.section_title: 降低风险：熟悉的规则从哪里来
shots.scene: 三个图标：一个叉、一个下降箭头、一把锁
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a hazard crossed out, a downward arrow, and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 安全管理就是消除、减少、控制危害。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔，最宽的顶层亮起
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid with its widest top layer glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 控制措施分五层，最宽的顶层是消除。

shots.scene: 第二、三层亮起：交换箭头和隔离墙
shots.prompt_en: The second and third layers light up: a swap arrow and a protective wall icon. No people.
shots.narration: 往下是替代，再往下是工程控制。

shots.scene: 第四、五层亮起：写字板和手套
shots.prompt_en: The fourth and fifth layers light up: a clipboard and a glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 然后是管理控制，最底层是个人防护。

shots.scene: 一个从上往下的大箭头，旁边对勾
shots.prompt_en: A large arrow running from the top layer down to the bottom, with a green check at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 越往上越有效，优先从上往下选。

shots.scene: 大部分风险在上层被挡住的示意
shots.prompt_en: Many red dots representing risks are stopped at the upper wide layers, only a few reach the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 大部分风险，应在上层解决。

shots.scene: 一张菜单被打叉，旁边是带编号的台阶
shots.prompt_en: A restaurant-style menu card crossed out, next to numbered steps going down. No people.
shots.narration: 控制层级不是菜单，不能随便挑。

shots.scene: 一大箱手套堆满，通风柜旁问号
shots.prompt_en: A huge pile of glove boxes fills a corner while a fume hood stands unused with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 很多实验室做反了：大批买手套。

shots.scene: “戴上手套就行”的对话气泡被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble with a glove icon is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 上层措施却舍不得投入，这是错的。

shots.scene: 上层盾牌稳固，下层一个打哈欠的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A solid shield at the top layer, and a yawning person pictogram at the bottom layer. No people.
shots.narration: 各层最大的差别，是可靠性。

shots.scene: 人手一滑，上层的隔离罩仍挡住
shots.prompt_en: A hand slips near an enclosure, but the enclosure still blocks the splash. No faces.
shots.narration: 层级越高，人犯了错也不怕。

shots.scene: 疲劳、着急、分心三个图标指向底层
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a tired face, a clock and a phone, point at the bottom layer. No people.
shots.narration: 越往下，一累一急一分心就失效。

shots.scene: 骰子图标和手套，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon next to a glove, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只靠防护，等于赌人从不出错。

shots.scene: 一个危害图标被整个擦掉
shots.prompt_en: A hazard warning icon is erased completely from a blank board. No people.
shots.narration: 最有力的是消除：危害没了就伤不了人。

shots.scene: 老李把高处的坏风扇拆下来，在地面上修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes a broken ceiling fan down and repairs it on a workbench at floor level.
shots.narration: 风扇拆到地面修，就没有坠落风险。

shots.scene: 地面上的杂物被收进柜子，通道变整洁
shots.prompt_en: Clutter on the floor is put away into a cabinet, leaving a clear walkway. No people.
shots.narration: 东西收好，就不会掉落和绊倒人。

shots.scene: 改用新的分析方法，旧试剂瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A new analysis method card replaces an old one, and a suspected carcinogen bottle is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 改了方法，就去掉了疑似致癌物。

shots.scene: 高毒试剂瓶换成低毒试剂瓶，交换箭头
shots.prompt_en: A high-toxicity reagent bottle is swapped for a low-toxicity one, with a swap arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 去不掉，就换成更安全的低毒试剂。

shots.scene: 肥皂水代替腐蚀性清洗剂
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of soapy water replaces a bottle with a corrosive pictogram for cleaning. No people.
shots.narration: 用肥皂水，代替腐蚀性清洗剂。

shots.scene: 受限空间里换成安全电压灯具
shots.prompt_en: In a confined space, an ordinary lamp is swapped for a low-voltage safety lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 可能有可燃气体，换用安全电压灯具。

shots.scene: 换溶剂后，废液桶变少，绿叶图标
shots.prompt_en: After a solvent swap, a row of waste containers shrinks to one, with a green leaf icon. No people.
shots.narration: 换了溶剂，废物也少了，安全又绿色。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 一道墙把人形图标和危害图标隔开
shots.prompt_en: A wall separates a person pictogram from a hazard icon. No people.
shots.narration: 换不了，就用设施把人和危害隔开。
overlay: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 通风柜把蒸气从源头抽走
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood draws vapor away at the source. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜在源头抽走蒸气，减少吸入。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 手套箱和生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: A glove box and a biological safety cabinet side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 手套箱、生物安全柜，也是工程控制。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 转动部件装上防护罩，旁边急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: A rotating machine part covered by a guard, with a red emergency stop button beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 防护罩、急停装置，靠设备不靠记性。

shots.scene: 防溅挡板挡住飞溅
shots.prompt_en: A transparent splash shield on a bench blocks flying droplets. No people.
shots.narration: 防溅挡板，挡住意外飞溅。

shots.scene: 【实拍】通风柜视窗拉到标示高度以下，双手在柜内深处操作（固定机位，柜门标线特写，用清水模拟）
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood sash is lowered below the marked height line, and gloved hands work deep inside the hood.
shots.narration: 视窗放低，在柜内深处操作。

shots.scene: 柜门大开、杂物堆满的通风柜被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with its sash fully open and cluttered with bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用错了，只会带来虚假的安全感。

shots.scene: 五层倒金字塔，第三层亮起，前两层打勾
shots.prompt_en: The inverted pyramid with the third layer glowing and the top two layers marked with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制可靠，但排第三，不是最有效。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 一个表盘：少接触、短接触、低浓度
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a small drop, a short timer and a diluted beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制，改变的是做事的方式。
overlay: 管理控制：改变做事方式

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 老周在审批单上签字，旁边放大的反应瓶
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank approval form beside an icon of a larger reaction flask.
shots.narration: 扩大反应规模，要先审批。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰结伴做实验，时钟显示白天
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work together at a bench, a wall clock shows daytime.
shots.narration: 危险实验结伴做，安排在有人的时段。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 阿杰举手示意停下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises a hand to signal stop.
shots.narration: 发现不对，人人都可以叫停。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives a training session to students.
shots.narration: 管理措施一是培训：懂危害，会操作。

shots.scene: 门口贴着警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A warning sign and a mandatory goggles sign on a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 二是标识：提醒危险，提示怎么做。

shots.scene: 一份分步骤的规程，步骤图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank step-by-step procedure sheet with numbered step icons lighting up in order. No people.
shots.narration: 三是操作规程，一步一步写清楚。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰按同一份规程做，结果一致
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student follow the same procedure sheet with the same safe result.
shots.narration: 谁来做，都一样安全。

shots.section_title: 管理措施靠执行和监督
shots.scene: 写好的规定被锁进抽屉、落灰，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A rule sheet is locked in a drawer gathering dust, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 规定写了不执行，等于没有。
overlay: 管理措施靠执行和监督

shots.section_title: 管理措施靠执行和监督
shots.scene: 清晨阿杰打哈欠，王老师在旁提醒
shots.prompt_en: Early in the morning the young male student yawns at the bench while the safety administrator reminds him.
shots.narration: 人会疲劳犯迷糊，要靠监督和自觉。

shots.section_title: 管理措施靠执行和监督
shots.scene: 高危操作图标旁一盏警示灯
shots.prompt_en: A high-risk operation icon next to a flashing warning lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 高危操作，这一层要时刻警惕。

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 倒金字塔最底层的手套和护目镜亮起
shots.prompt_en: The bottom layer of the inverted pyramid lights up with gloves and goggles icons. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护，是最后一道防线。
overlay: 个人防护是最后一道防线

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 护目镜挡在眼前，危害仍在
shots.prompt_en: Safety goggles sit between an eye icon and a hazard icon; the hazard is still there. No people.
shots.narration: 它不消除危害，只是隔开一层。

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 通风柜报警灯亮，只剩护目镜和手套挡着
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood alarm light is on, and only goggles and gloves remain between the person pictogram and the vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜一失灵，只剩它挡在前面。

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴好护目镜，戴手套并把袖口压在手套下（手部和面部下半部特写，人物不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a person puts on safety goggles, then gloves pulled over the lab coat cuffs.
shots.narration: 选对、穿好，关键时刻才保得住你。

shots.section_title: 靠防护挡住，说明前面失守
shots.scene: 手套上沾了一滴液体，前面几层都有裂缝
shots.prompt_en: A drop of liquid lands on a glove, while the upper layers of the pyramid show cracks. No people.
shots.narration: 真靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守了。
overlay: 靠防护挡住，说明前面失守

shots.section_title: 靠防护挡住，说明前面失守
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，老周记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who writes it down on a blank form.
shots.narration: 这已是险情，要报告、查原因。

shots.section_title: 靠防护挡住，说明前面失守
shots.scene: 倒金字塔上层被补上
shots.prompt_en: The cracks in the upper layers of the pyramid are repaired one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 把前面的漏洞补上。

shots.scene: 几片有孔的奶酪片叠在一起，孔不重合
shots.prompt_en: Several slices with holes stacked in a row, the holes not lining up, stopping an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 每层防护都有漏洞。

shots.scene: 箭头穿过第一片，被第二片挡住
shots.prompt_en: An arrow passes through the first slice but is stopped by the second slice. No people.
shots.narration: 一层失手，下一层还能接住。

shots.scene: 三道防线：通风柜、规程、护目镜同时亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three lines of defense light up at once: a fume hood, a procedure sheet and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 高危操作，几层措施一起上。

shots.scene: 只有一道防线被击穿，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A single thin barrier is pierced by an arrow, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让小失误，击穿唯一的防线。

shots.section_title: 学生在实验室能做的三层
shots.scene: 老周在办公室设计实验，倒金字塔上两层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The older man designs an experiment at a desk, while the top two layers of the pyramid glow.
shots.narration: 消除和替代，多在设计实验时完成。
overlay: 学生在实验室能做的三层

shots.section_title: 学生在实验室能做的三层
shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台前，下三层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a bench, while the bottom three layers of the pyramid glow.
shots.narration: 在实验台前，你能做的是下面三层。

shots.section_title: 学生在实验室能做的三层
shots.scene: 暴露可能性指针下降
shots.prompt_en: A likelihood dial for exposure drops from high to low. No people.
shots.narration: 降低暴露的可能，就是降低风险。

shots.section_title: 发现措施缺失，及时报告
shots.scene: 通风柜报警灯亮，阿杰停下手里的操作
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood alarm light flashes and the young male student stops his work.
shots.narration: 通风柜报警、防护罩缺了，先停下。
overlay: 发现措施缺失，及时报告

shots.section_title: 发现措施缺失，及时报告
shots.scene: 报告链：实验室负责人、学院、实验室管理处
shots.prompt_en: A reporting chain of three icons: a lab supervisor, a school office building and a university office. No people.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人，报修。

shots.section_title: 发现措施缺失，及时报告
shots.scene: 擅自拆改设施的扳手图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A wrench icon tampering with a guard is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不擅自拆改，修好再做。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: The five layers of the inverted pyramid get green checks one by one from the top. No people.
shots.narration: 消除、替代、工程、管理、防护。

shots.scene: 多道防线一起亮起，手套在最后
shots.prompt_en: Several lines of defense glow together, with gloves at the very end. No people.
shots.narration: 从上往下选，组合用，防护是最后一道。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一个小烧杯和一个大烧杯挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small beaker and a large beaker side by side and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲化学实验风险最小化。
